message: border-radius isn't supported in Outlook Windows; partly in Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android (5 places)
hint: Round corners can be used in VML with the `RoundRect` element. See the [VML documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/vml/msdn-online-vml-roundrect-element).

message: Transparent image may vanish in dark mode
hint: Gmail apps and Outlook darken the background behind it, so dark ink disappears. Give it a light outline or a solid background baked into the image.
